description: Flick ice blocks across the rink to smash every crystal target! Drag back and release to launch.
fireSafetyLesson: Ice on a hot stove? Never pour water on a grease fire — smother it with a lid!
title: CINDER'S ICE RINK CHAOS

description: Drag to steer your sky-ballista! Auto-fires upward — dodge rock fortresses and blast them apart.
fireSafetyLesson: Fireworks are for grown-ups only — never touch them yourself!
title: LORD INFERNO'S BALLISTA SIEGE

description: Sumo showdown in a lava ring! Fling Blaze to bump rock golems out of the arena.
fireSafetyLesson: Hot lava is like a hot stove — look but NEVER touch!
title: BLAZE'S MAGMA BOUNCE

description: Notes fall down 4 lanes — tap each lane when the note hits the target zone!
fireSafetyLesson: Smoke alarms save lives — test yours every month with a grown-up!
title: RUKO'S TURBO DRIFT

description: Tilt or tap to steer — Sizzle auto-bounces ever higher! Grab stars, avoid the fall.
fireSafetyLesson: Climbing high? Always have a grown-up nearby to spot you!
title: SIZZLE'S SPARK JUMP

description: Tap glowing spots to place fire baby defenders! They auto-blast rock invaders down 3 lanes.
fireSafetyLesson: A fire needs fuel, heat, and oxygen — remove one and the fire dies!
title: EMBER CASCADE

description: Swap adjacent ember blocks to match 3 or more! Score 2000 points in 30 moves.
fireSafetyLesson: Matches are tools, not toys — only grown-ups should use them!
title: CALDERA CLIMB

description: Tap to jump, double-tap for double jump! Dodge lava geysers and grab crystals.
fireSafetyLesson: If fire blocks your path, never try to jump over it — get LOW, get OUT, call 911!
title: MAGMA TRENCH DODGE

description: Tap LEFT/RIGHT to flip! Keep the fireball alive, smash bumpers for combos. 3 balls!
fireSafetyLesson: Balls bounce — but never bounce near a hot stove or fireplace!
title: VOLCANIC PINBALL

description: Drag the paddle to bounce the fireball! Break every rock brick — don't let it fall!
fireSafetyLesson: Walls protect us from fire — never block your escape routes with furniture!
title: PYRA PRIME DEFENSE

description: Steer the ember trail with d-pad or swipe! Eat crystals to grow, avoid yourself.
fireSafetyLesson: A trail of embers can start a fire — always fully put out campfires!
title: SPARKY SPEEDWAY

description: Flip two cards at a time — find all 8 matching fire baby pairs! Fewer flips wins.
fireSafetyLesson: Remember your family's fire escape plan — practice it twice a year!
title: CINDER'S MELT-DOWN

description: Tap rock moles as they pop from lava holes! Golden moles = bonus. Never bonk fire babies!
fireSafetyLesson: Hot lava holes are like hot grills — stay back and let grown-ups handle them!
title: INFERNO DROP
